_comment: Curated per-quant weights-bytes and architecture facts for VRAM estimation. Figures sourced from Ollama manifest/config-blob API (ollama.com tags page, registry.ollama.ai v2 API) where marked 'ollama'; otherwise plausible+documented figures are used and marked accordingly. The offline tool (cmd/bestiary-ollama) refreshes these from live Ollama registry data. VRAMBytes and VRAMContextTokens are NOT stored here — they are computed and baked by the codegen caller (cmd/bestiary-gen) using EstimateVRAMBytes.

models._comment: llama-3.3-70b-instruct: arch facts from Meta-Llama-3.3-70B public model card; weights_bytes from ollama.com/library/llama3.3/tags (manifest layer size). Q4_K_M ~42.5 GB, Q8_0 ~75 GB, F16 ~141 GB as of 2026-06-09.
llama3.2:3b-instruct: param_size and weights_bytes from ollama.com/library/llama3.2 tags page (Q4_K_M ~2.0 GB). Arch facts absent — exercises the partial-VRAM code path.

qwen2.5:0.5b-instruct: small model entry. param_size and weights_bytes from ollama.com/library/qwen2.5 tags page (Q4_K_M ~397 MB). Arch facts absent — exercises partial-VRAM path alongside the 3b entry.

dracarys2-llama-3-70b-instruct: community finetune of llama-3-70b-instruct. base_ref exercises the finetune-with-base_ref code path. Weights_bytes are plausible+documented (same Q4_K_M class as a 70B model). The offline tool provides authoritative figures on next refresh.
